### Health Analytics with R · Module 04: Machine Learning for Clinical Prediction
***
**Learning objectives**
- Understand gradient boosting conceptually (additive trees, residual fitting)
- Train XGBoost and LightGBM with clinical-appropriate hyperparameters
- Use `tune::tune_bayes` for efficient Bayesian hyperparameter optimisation
- Handle categorical features natively in LightGBM
- Interpret early stopping and learning curves to prevent overfitting

**Estimated time:** 2.5 hours | **Level:** Intermediate → Advanced | **Libraries:** `xgboost`, `lightgbm`, `tune`, `dials`, `tidymodels`

## 1. Setup & Dataset

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(xgboost)
library(lightgbm)
library(ranger)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_purple <- "#7C3AED"; col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"

auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

cat(sprintf("XGBoost %s\n", as.character(packageVersion("xgboost"))))
cat(sprintf("LightGBM %s\n", as.character(packageVersion("lightgbm"))))

# ── Dataset ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42); N <- 3000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
split_te <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr_all <- training(split_te); df_te <- testing(split_te)
split_val <- initial_split(df_tr_all, prop = 0.85, strata = readmitted)
df_tr2 <- training(split_val); df_val <- testing(split_val)

rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr2) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr2)
bake_x <- function(newdata) bake(rec_prep, new_data = newdata) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr_tbl  <- bake_x(df_tr2); Xval_tbl <- bake_x(df_val); Xte_tbl <- bake_x(df_te)
Xtr  <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl);  Xval <- as.matrix(Xval_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)
y_tr2 <- as.integer(as.character(df_tr2$readmitted))
y_val  <- as.integer(as.character(df_val$readmitted))
y_te   <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))
feat_nm <- colnames(Xtr)
scale_pos <- sum(y_tr2 == 0) / sum(y_tr2 == 1)
cat(sprintf("Train:%s | Val:%s | Test:%s\n",
            paste(dim(Xtr), collapse = " x "),
            paste(dim(Xval), collapse = " x "),
            paste(dim(Xte), collapse = " x ")))
cat(sprintf("scale_pos_weight for XGBoost: %.2f\n", scale_pos))
```

## 2. Gradient Boosting — Conceptual Overview

```
Iteration 0:  predict mean (F₀)
Iteration 1:  fit a tree to residuals r₁ = y - F₀  →  F₁ = F₀ + η·h₁
Iteration 2:  fit a tree to residuals r₂ = y - F₁  →  F₂ = F₁ + η·h₂
...
Iteration T:  F_T = F₀ + η·Σ hₜ
```

| Concept | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Learning rate η** | Shrinks each tree's contribution — smaller = more trees needed but better generalization |
| **n_estimators** | Number of trees — use early stopping to find optimal T |
| **max_depth** | Tree depth — shallower = more regularization |
| **subsample / colsample** | Stochastic gradient boosting — reduces overfitting |
| **scale_pos_weight** | XGBoost class-imbalance correction = N_neg / N_pos |

```{r}
# ── XGBoost with early stopping ───────────────────────────────────────────────
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(Xtr,  label = y_tr2)
dval   <- xgb.DMatrix(Xval, label = y_val)
dte    <- xgb.DMatrix(Xte,  label = y_te)

xgb_params <- list(
  objective        = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric      = "auc",
  eta              = 0.05,          # learning rate
  max_depth        = 6,
  subsample        = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  scale_pos_weight = scale_pos,     # handle class imbalance
  seed             = 42,
  verbosity        = 0
)
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = xgb_params, data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  evals = list(train = dtrain, val = dval),
  early_stopping_rounds = 30,
  verbose = 0
)
prob_xgb <- predict(xgb_model, dte)
auc_xgb  <- auc_prob(y_te, prob_xgb)
best_iter_xgb <- attr(xgb_model, "early_stop")$best_iteration
if (is.null(best_iter_xgb)) best_iter_xgb <- xgb.get.num.boosted.rounds(xgb_model)
cat(sprintf("XGBoost: best_iteration=%d, AUC=%.4f\n", best_iter_xgb, auc_xgb))

# Learning curve
ev <- as_tibble(attr(xgb_model, "evaluation_log"))
p_lc <- ggplot(ev, aes(iter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_auc, colour = "Train AUC"), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = val_auc,   colour = "Val AUC"),   linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_iter_xgb, colour = col_green, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Train AUC" = col_blue, "Val AUC" = col_red)) +
  labs(x = "Boosting round", y = "AUC", colour = NULL,
       title = "XGBoost learning curve — early stopping",
       subtitle = sprintf("Best iteration = %d", best_iter_xgb))
print(p_lc)
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "xgb_learning_curve.png"), p_lc, width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 120)
```

```{r}
# ── LightGBM — faster, handles categoricals natively ─────────────────────────
df_lgb <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CATEGORIC), as.factor))
X_lgb <- df_lgb %>% select(all_of(c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC)))
y_lgb <- df_lgb[[TARGET]]
set.seed(42)
# Recreate the same 80/20 then 85/15 splits on the categorical-aware frame
lgb_ml <- X_lgb %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_lgb, levels = c(0, 1)))
sp_te  <- initial_split(lgb_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
Xl_tr_all <- training(sp_te); Xl_te <- testing(sp_te)
sp_val <- initial_split(Xl_tr_all, prop = 0.85, strata = readmitted)
Xl_tr2 <- training(sp_val); Xl_val <- testing(sp_val)
yl_tr2 <- as.integer(as.character(Xl_tr2$readmitted))
yl_val  <- as.integer(as.character(Xl_val$readmitted))
yl_te   <- as.integer(as.character(Xl_te$readmitted))
Xl_tr2_x <- Xl_tr2 %>% select(-readmitted)
Xl_val_x <- Xl_val %>% select(-readmitted)
Xl_te_x  <- Xl_te  %>% select(-readmitted)

# LightGBM wants integer codes for categoricals
to_lgb_mat <- function(d) {
  d2 <- d
  for (col in CATEGORIC) d2[[col]] <- as.integer(d2[[col]]) - 1L
  as.matrix(d2)
}
cat_idx <- match(CATEGORIC, names(Xl_tr2_x)) - 1L  # 0-based for lightgbm
dtrain_l <- lgb.Dataset(to_lgb_mat(Xl_tr2_x), label = yl_tr2, categorical_feature = cat_idx)
dval_l   <- lgb.Dataset(to_lgb_mat(Xl_val_x),  label = yl_val,  categorical_feature = cat_idx,
                        reference = dtrain_l)

lgb_params <- list(
  objective        = "binary",
  metric           = "auc",
  learning_rate    = 0.05,
  num_leaves       = 31,
  max_depth        = -1,
  subsample        = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  is_unbalance     = TRUE,
  verbosity        = -1,
  seed             = 42
)
lgb_model <- lgb.train(
  params = lgb_params, data = dtrain_l,
  nrounds = 500,
  valids = list(train = dtrain_l, val = dval_l),
  early_stopping_rounds = 30,
  verbose = -1
)
prob_lgb <- predict(lgb_model, to_lgb_mat(Xl_te_x))
auc_lgb  <- auc_prob(yl_te, prob_lgb)
cat(sprintf("LightGBM: best_iteration=%d, AUC=%.4f\n", lgb_model$best_iter, auc_lgb))
```

## 3. Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimisation (`tune::tune_bayes`)

```{r}
set.seed(42)
# parsnip boost_tree (xgboost engine) + Bayesian optimisation (tune_bayes)
# analogue of Optuna TPE search
xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(),
  sample_size = tune(), min_n = tune(), mtry = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost", scale_pos_weight = scale_pos) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

bayes_data <- Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr2, levels = c(0, 1)))
xgb_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_spec) %>%
  add_formula(readmitted ~ .)

folds <- vfold_cv(bayes_data, v = 3, strata = readmitted)
p_feat <- ncol(Xtr)

xgb_param <- extract_parameter_set_dials(xgb_wf) %>%
  update(
    trees      = trees(range = c(100L, 500L)),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(range = c(3L, 8L)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(range = c(-2, log10(0.3))),
    sample_size = sample_prop(range = c(0.6, 1.0)),
    min_n      = min_n(range = c(5L, 30L)),
    mtry       = mtry(range = c(max(1L, floor(sqrt(p_feat))), max(2L, floor(p_feat / 2))))
  )

bayes_res <- tune_bayes(
  xgb_wf, resamples = folds, param_info = xgb_param,
  initial = 8, iter = 22,
  metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
  control = control_bayes(no_improve = 8, verbose = FALSE)
)

best_bayes <- show_best(bayes_res, metric = "roc_auc", n = 1)
cat(sprintf("tune_bayes best AUC: %.4f\n", best_bayes$mean))
cat("Best params:\n")
print(select_best(bayes_res, metric = "roc_auc"))

met <- collect_metrics(bayes_res) %>%
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
  arrange(.iter) %>%
  mutate(
    trial = row_number(),
    best_so_far = cummax(mean)
  )

p_hist <- ggplot(met, aes(trial, mean)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#93C5FD", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = best_so_far), colour = col_navy, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Trial", y = "CV AUC", title = "tune_bayes optimisation history")

# Parameter importance via range of top configs (vip on final model below)
final_bayes <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf, select_best(bayes_res, metric = "roc_auc")) %>%
  fit(bayes_data)
vi_bayes <- vip::vi(extract_fit_parsnip(final_bayes)$fit) %>% slice_max(Importance, n = 8)
p_imp <- ggplot(vi_bayes, aes(Importance, reorder(Variable, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = col_red, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(x = "Importance", y = NULL, title = "XGBoost feature importance (best config)")

p_hist + p_imp
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "tune_bayes.png"), width = 13, height = 4, dpi = 120)
```

## 4. Model Comparison Summary

```{r}
set.seed(42)
# Logistic regression
lr_df <- Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(y = y_tr2)
w_lr <- ifelse(y_tr2 == 1, 0.5 / mean(y_tr2 == 1), 0.5 / mean(y_tr2 == 0))
lr <- glm(y ~ ., data = lr_df, family = binomial, weights = w_lr)
p_lr <- predict(lr, newdata = Xte_tbl, type = "response")

# Random forest
rf <- ranger(
  readmitted ~ ., data = Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr2, levels = c(0, 1))),
  probability = TRUE, num.trees = 200, max.depth = 10,
  class.weights = c("0" = 1 / mean(y_tr2 == 0), "1" = 1 / mean(y_tr2 == 1)),
  seed = 42
)
p_rf <- predict(rf, data = Xte_tbl)$predictions[, "1"]

model_probs <- list("Logistic Reg" = p_lr, "Random Forest" = p_rf,
                    "XGBoost" = prob_xgb, "LightGBM" = prob_lgb)
colors_m <- c("Logistic Reg" = col_green, "Random Forest" = col_blue,
              "XGBoost" = col_red, "LightGBM" = col_purple)

summary_tbl <- imap_dfr(model_probs, function(prob, name) {
  tibble(Model = name,
         AUC = auc_prob(y_te, prob),
         `Avg Precision` = ap_prob(y_te, prob),
         Brier = brier_prob(y_te, prob))
}) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC))

roc_all <- imap_dfr(model_probs, function(prob, name) {
  yardstick::roc_curve(
    tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = prob),
    truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
  ) %>% mutate(Model = sprintf("%s (%.3f)", name, auc_prob(y_te, prob)),
               key = name)
})

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_all, aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity, colour = key)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors_m) +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", colour = NULL,
       title = "ROC curves — Gradient Boosting comparison") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

summ_long <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(`1-Brier` = 1 - Brier) %>%
  select(Model, AUC, `Avg Precision`, `1-Brier`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Model, names_to = "metric", values_to = "score")

p_bar <- ggplot(summ_long, aes(Model, score, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("AUC" = col_blue, "Avg Precision" = col_red, "1-Brier" = col_green)) +
  labs(y = "Score", x = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Model comparison — key metrics") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

p_roc + p_bar
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "xgb_lgb_comparison.png"), width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 120)
cat("\nModel comparison table:\n")
print(summary_tbl)
```

## 5. Knowledge Check
1. XGBoost stopped at iteration 87 out of 500. What does this tell you about the learning rate and regularization?
2. LightGBM grows leaf-wise while XGBoost grows level-wise. What are the practical implications for clinical datasets with few features?
3. `scale_pos_weight` was set to 6.8 (ratio of negatives to positives). What would happen if you forgot this parameter?
4. Your `tune_bayes` study ran 30 trials. The best AUC is 0.78. Would 100 more trials likely improve this substantially?
5. Re-run LightGBM with `learning_rate=0.01` and `nrounds=1000`. Does it converge to the same AUC?

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — LightGBM with lower learning rate
lgb_params_slow <- lgb_params
lgb_params_slow$learning_rate <- 0.01
lgb_slow <- lgb.train(
  params = lgb_params_slow, data = dtrain_l,
  nrounds = 1000,
  valids = list(val = dval_l),
  early_stopping_rounds = 50,
  verbose = -1
)
prob_slow <- predict(lgb_slow, to_lgb_mat(Xl_te_x))
cat(sprintf("LightGBM lr=0.05: AUC=%.4f  (best_iter=%d)\n", auc_lgb, lgb_model$best_iter))
cat(sprintf("LightGBM lr=0.01: AUC=%.4f  (best_iter=%d)\n",
            auc_prob(yl_te, prob_slow), lgb_slow$best_iter))
cat("Smaller LR needs more iterations but often achieves similar final AUC.\n")
```
